_comment: run_24a: Allee pinned weak, demography free. Built on run_23a (single field, occupied centring, juvenile survival as a fraction of adult, K level 3.0 +/- 1.0).

2x2 factorial on the two demands every fit keeps (lambda0 ~ 2 at typical habitat; strong absolute Allee, n50 ~ 0.28 route counts) -- they survived every structural change and were pushed 6-10 prior sds past firm priors in run_23a. Cells: run_23a (both free), 24a (Allee pinned weak), 24b (demography pinned), 24c (both pinned). Pinned = numpyro condition (population_model.pinned_sites): not fitted; habitat sensitivities stay free, so lambda varies in space around the pinned typical-habitat value.

Pinned values: adult survival 0.6 (alpha_a = logit 0.6), juvenile/adult ratio 0.5 (alpha_j = 0), fecundity 4 per adult (alpha_f = softplus^-1(4)) -> lambda0 ~ 1.2 at typical occupied habitat; Allee n50 = 0.03 route counts (n50_raw = softplus^-1(0.03)). Read the residual maps (figures 04/08) of each pinned cell for WHERE the data resist.
